fact: UNDP terms of reference signed 22 April 2021 state that the Gambia Police Force's mobile crime-reporting app, feeding its existing digital Case Management System, was still in its pilot phase covering the four most reported crimes, was to be upgraded to all crimes and expanded in phases to other police stations with priority to those with ICT capacity, lets officers input data offline and upload it to the centralised CMS, and will be owned by the Gambia Police Force with UNDP and the Police overseeing the work.
title: Term of Reference (ToR) for the Recruitment of Consultant: Upgrade the Mobile Application for Reporting Crime/Training and Mentorship
